categories.main_business_segments: Hubei Chaozhuo Aviation Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in customized additive manufacturing and airborne equipment maintenance. Its core business includes additive manufacturing of aerospace parts and consumables, precision processing equipment and parts manufacturing for strip and plate forming, and additive manufacturing of new energy vehicle parts. The company also provides maintenance services for airborne equipment and produces sputtering target materials for electronics and semiconductor industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in cold spray solid-state additive manufacturing technology, which involves accelerating powder particles to supersonic speeds to deposit dense coatings without melting the particles, thus minimizing thermal damage. It has developed proprietary low-pressure and high-pressure cold spray technologies, mobile additive manufacturing platforms for in-situ aircraft structural repairs, and advanced coating technologies such as ultra-hard tungsten carbide coatings. The company integrates additive and subtractive manufacturing techniques and focuses on multi-metal composite materials and functional metal coatings.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include a major domestic aerospace client and its affiliated aircraft overhaul factories, other aviation industry groups, domestic airlines such as China Southern Airlines and Air China, steel and metallurgical enterprises, and automotive parts manufacturers. The company serves both military and civil aviation sectors, new energy vehicle manufacturers, and industrial equipment producers, with products applied in aircraft structural repairs, engine parts, electronic devices, and automotive thermal management systems.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with headquarters in Xiangyang, Hubei Province, and subsidiaries in Shanghai, Luoyang, Chengdu, and Zhangjiagang. Its market coverage includes domestic aerospace overhaul bases, automotive manufacturing hubs, and industrial regions. There is no significant foreign operation disclosed, though some raw materials are imported.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hubei Chaozhuo Aviation Technology operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the aerospace and manufacturing supply chain. It focuses on additive manufacturing and repair services for aerospace structural components and airborne equipment, as well as manufacturing precision parts for automotive and industrial machinery. It procures raw materials such as metal powders and industrial gases, some of which are imported, and supplies finished components and maintenance services to OEMs and overhaul facilities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in cold spray solid-state additive manufacturing technology, expanding applications in aerospace, new energy vehicles, industrial machinery, and electronics. It invests heavily in R&D, focusing on equipment integration, gas recovery systems, powder deposition efficiency, and coating performance. The firm also develops new materials, such as Ti2AlNb alloys and high-strength coatings, and advances automation and intelligent manufacturing technologies. It aims to maintain technological leadership and broaden market applications while optimizing cost and efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized additive manufactured products, precision equipment, and new energy vehicle parts, as well as maintenance and repair services for airborne equipment. The company operates on a direct sales model, with contracts and orders based on customer specifications and acceptance. It also earns income from leasing investment properties and financial investments. Government subsidies and investment income contribute marginally to overall revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the few domestic enterprises mastering cold spray solid-state additive manufacturing technology and is a leading supplier in the aerospace structural repair market, especially as the sole supplier for fatigue crack repairs of aircraft landing gear beams at major overhaul bases. It holds a strong first-mover advantage with proprietary technologies and deep customer relationships, positioning it as a specialized expert in multi-scenario additive manufacturing applications in China. Competition exists in the broader additive manufacturing and aerospace maintenance sectors but the company’s niche technology and certifications provide a competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 403.58 million, a 49.38% increase year-over-year, and returned to profitability with a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 12.99 million, reversing a prior loss. Total assets stood at about RMB 1.60 billion, with a slight decrease from the previous year. The company maintains a strong R&D investment ratio of 7.36% of revenue. It has steadily expanded through acquisitions and organic growth, with a workforce of 530 employees including 84 R&D personnel.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its advanced cold spray solid-state additive manufacturing technology that enables low-thermal-impact, high-strength, and dense metal coatings for repair and manufacturing, which traditional methods cannot achieve. Its mobile additive manufacturing platforms allow in-situ aircraft structural repairs, enhancing operational efficiency and aircraft lifespan. The firm offers customized solutions across aerospace, automotive, and industrial sectors, with superior coating performance, multi-metal bonding capabilities, and environmentally friendly processes. Its strong certifications, exclusive supplier status for key aerospace repairs, and continuous innovation underpin its differentiated market position.
